content:
**archive.test.mjs stops writing scratch/ into the real repo root; a source-level guard keeps the class closed**

Measured (#1020): a cold-review candidate that runs the suite is refused for +scratch because archive.test.mjs 4.1 built its sandbox under join(process.cwd(), 'scratch/test-archive-sandbox') and left the scratch/ parent behind. Moved the sandbox to testTmp() (brain/scripts/lib/test-tmp.mjs, #842's per-run tmp root) and resolved scriptPath via import.meta.url instead of process.cwd(), verified with a before/after real-root entry-list snapshot. Added brain/scripts/test-hygiene.test.mjs, a source-level guard scanning *.test.mjs under brain/scripts/** and test/** for a write call (mkdirSync/writeFileSync/symlinkSync/cpSync) whose own argument list directly references process.cwd()/resolve('.'); scope is the direct inline form only (whole-file variable tracing false-positives on installed-version.test.mjs's four same-named, different-scope root bindings). Full suite: 5595/5595 pass; scratch/ and .engram both absent from the real repo root afterward.
